Rollback Plan

Rollback plan using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

rollback_plan(stages)

Example input

{
  "stages": [
    {
      "stage": "switch reads",
      "trigger": "error rate rises",
      "rollback": "restore legacy reads",
      "verification": "run compatibility checks"
    }
  ]
}

Example output

[
  {
    "stage": "switch reads",
    "trigger": "error rate rises",
    "rollback": "restore legacy reads",
    "verification": "run compatibility checks"
  }
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py rollback_plan < examples/rollback-plan.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
